name: CLK
description: Automatically opens HTTPS destinations encoded in full links.
script: function resolve(input) { if(input.path!=='/full' && input.path!=='/full/') return null; var raw=input.query.url; if(typeof raw!=='string' || !raw) return null; try { var target=decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(raw))); if(!/^https:\/\//i.test(target) || /[\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/.test(target)) return null; return {url:target}; } catch(e) { return null; } }

attribution.note: Original local decoder for the observed clk.sh /full?url=Base64 format. Does not read api keys or contact an external resolver.
